title: Q-STD-otel: Turn on OpenTelemetry export
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation openstd --probe observability
**Status:** closed

OPEN-STANDARDS-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25): enable Workers OTLP export for the tick Worker and map tick steps to spans; add the setting to its wrangler config and a test that reads it.

size: M
**Out of scope:** new formats not in doctrine/open-standards.json.

Prediction: open_standards_adopted_rows >= 10 within 168 h

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation openstd --check passes and the registry row for observability reads adopted with evidence files that exist.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T12:44:52Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
